name: Enable Pull Request Automerge
description: A GitHub action to enable auto-merge on a pull request

token.description: GITHUB_TOKEN or a `repo` scoped Personal Access Token (PAT)

repository.description: The target GitHub repository containing the pull request

pull-request-number.description: The number of the target pull request

merge-method.description: The merge method to use. `merge`, `rebase` or `squash`.
